notable.note: The most serious clinical exposure in this batch. The prospect disclosed a symptomatic, undiagnosed suspected pinched nerve in his shoulder that several chiropractors have not resolved and for which he is considering physical therapy. Nobody asked whether he had been cleared to train, and the rep proceeded to give him specific loading advice for kettlebell snatches — an overhead ballistic movement directly loading that shoulder — and then moved him toward a self-guided programme where no coach observes his form. Separately, three different price points appear on a sixteen-minute call: 'at least four figures', 'between six and 1,200 monthly', and $200/month, plus a fourth unbuilt tier the rep says is coming.
